name: Canned Corn 2
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: corn cut from the cob
ingredients.originalText: 10 cups of corn cut from the cob

instructions.text: Mix together corn, sugar, and salt
Put in a kettle at the back of the stove until enough of the milk of the corn has exuded to cook it without adding water
Cook for 1 hour, watching carefully that it does not scorch
When you wish to use the corn take the required amount and put in cold water for 3 1/2 hours
Turn off the salty water and prepare with milk and butter

source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix together corn, sugar, and salt
2. Put in a kettle at the back of the stove until enough of the milk of the corn has exuded to cook it without adding water
3. Cook for 1 hour, watching carefully that it does not scorch
4. Can and seal
5. When you wish to use the corn take the required amount and put in cold water for 3 1/2 hours
6. Turn off the salty water and prepare with milk and butter
originalIngredients: 10 cups of corn cut from the cob
